name: InsertPolysIntersection
formula: =LAMBDA(verticesA,verticesB,LET(n, ROWS(verticesB), results, REDUCE(verticesA, SEQUENCE(n), LAMBDA(a,i, LET(xi, INDEX(verticesB, i, 1), yi, INDEX(verticesB, i, 2), xj, INDEX(verticesB, IF(i = n, 1, i + 1), 1), yj, INDEX(verticesB, IF(i = n, 1, i + 1), 2), {ref}InsertPolyAndLineIntersection(a, xi, yi, xj, yj)))), results))
comment: Inserts every intersection of polygon B into polygon A. verticesA and verticesB are n×2 arrays of (x, y) rows in order; the last vertex connects to the first. Each edge of B is passed to InsertPolyAndLineIntersection. The result is A with intersection rows marked TRUE. Polygons that do not meet return A with FALSE flags. Fewer than two columns returns #REF!. A non-numeric coordinate returns #VALUE!. Last Update at 2026-11-03.
